full_details: He said his father had walked the playhouse half the night with a lantern. Two hired men are to sleep in the tiring-house from tonight at sixpence each, and the yard gates are to be chained after the play. His father would fly the flag higher. He would have it down on a trouble day, since a white swan is a thing to throw at. You said keep it up. A house that hides looks guilty. He said that was his father's opinion, and that it was three to one once he heard it had been Heminges's first. After the call you tried a private account of the week and crossed out a phrase that would have sounded well in an alderman's mouth. What you kept was a list. Pell, two hundred. Verbeke, a silkweaver, English. Alse, Ludgate. You said that if you wrote them you would make them a crowd, and they were not. In the afternoon the bill was Fair Em, and you played.
one_sentence: Cuthbert called from Holywell about the timber house, you crossed out the alderman's sentence and left a list of three, and in the afternoon you played in Fair Em.
title: The flag up, and a list left as a list
